summary: An excerpt from a novel (Book 10, part 75) in which Trish and Damian talk in a Washington, DC office setting. Trish, an experienced Hill staffer, watches a young man from the Naval Academy on the phone and then advises Damian, who is new to the job, on how DC meetings carry hidden meanings. She explains that in DC a meeting during office hours always has a purpose, and that a meeting like the one Damian called would be read as an attempt to parley or strike a deal before her bill goes to committee.
one_line: Trish gives newcomer Damian a lesson on the hidden protocol of Washington meetings, where any scheduled meeting is read as having a purpose.
key_facts: Trish tells Damian that DC is a busy place where meetings have a purpose even when they appear to have none.
Trish says social get-togethers in DC happen strictly in evenings and weekends, after working hours.
Trish describes a secret meeting protocol known to every Hill Rat and written nowhere.
Trish says the time of a meeting, who attends, who is invited, how long it is scheduled, and whether it is catered all signal its purpose.
Trish states that even if a person has no reason to call a meeting, one will be read into it.
Trish says that calling her over for a meeting at this time of day in DC means Damian is looking to parley.
Trish says Damian wants to strike a deal before her bill goes to the committee.
Trish says that in any other city it would make perfect sense for Damian to look her up once he got to DC.
Trish says she and Damian are still friends and that she still thinks about him from time to time.
Trish says she does not want to impute motives to Damian because she does not know how well he knows the Hill.
Trish recalls the first lesson she learned on the Hill: 'If you're explaining -- you're losing.'
Damian says he is just learning as he goes and trying not to make too many mistakes.
Trish describes a young man who looked like he had gone top in his class at the Naval Academy, tilting his chair and laughing on the phone.
Trish guesses the person on the phone's other end is a key Congressman's aide, an old frat buddy of 'Mr Navy 2048'.
Damian's forehead crinkles at the end of the excerpt as he begins to respond.
